rationale: The golden submission is rejected because inputs/trace_pairs.json is not valid bare JSON: the shipped file begins with a long prose scratch-work narrative before the actual JSON object, causing json.loads() to throw 'Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)' when evaluate.py's SR3 independent DFA cross-check tries to parse it. This is confirmed by the differential run (golden_run status=fail, expected=pass) and the analyzer's high-severity finding that the manifest purpose statement claims the file was 'FIXED per repair notes' to be strictly valid bare JSON with zero surrounding content, but the actual shipped content still has the narrative preamble — i.e. a described repair was never actually applied to the artifact. All other requirement checks (FR1-FR4, SR1, SR2, SR4) pass correctly for golden and correctly fail for baseline, showing evaluate.py itself is sound; the defect is purely in the malformed input artifact. Because the golden is wrongly rejected, mutation testing is blocked entirely (mutation_status=blocked_by_differential, discrimination_coverage=0.0), so mutation_score=0.0 is not meaningful and the case cannot be retained as-is.
revision_instructions: Regenerate inputs/trace_pairs.json so it contains ONLY the bare JSON document (the top-level {"traces": [...]} object) with zero leading or trailing prose, narrative, or reasoning text -- the entire file content must be valid input to json.loads() with no surrounding characters. Preserve the same trace data structure and values (plaintext/key/correct_ciphertext/faulty_ciphertext fields) required by the fault_model.md description and consistent with a real differential fault analysis over final_key nibble 0, but strip all commentary that currently precedes the JSON object. After regenerating, re-run the differential test to confirm: (1) the golden submission now passes FR1-FR4 and SR1-SR4 (exit code 0, all [TEST] PASS), and (2) the baseline/insecure submission still fails at least SR1, SR2, SR3, SR4, and FR4 as before. Also add a simple JSON-validity self-check step to the artifact generation process (e.g. attempt json.load on the file and assert success) to prevent this class of malformed-artifact regression from recurring.
